options.title: Chhattisgarh, Uttarakhand, Jharkhand: ek hi mahine mein kaise bane? 🗺️
options.first_line: छत्तीसगढ़, उत्तराखंड और झारखंड, तीनों एक ही महीने में कैसे बने?
options.first_frame: India's map with Chhattisgarh, Uttarakhand and Jharkhand already painted in three bright colours, each name tag popping on as it is spoken.

options.title: Ek mahine mein teen naye state? November 2000 ka naksha 🗺️
options.first_line: एक ही महीने में नक्शे पर तीन नए स्टेट कैसे आ गए?
options.first_frame: All of India pale and waiting, three empty outlines blinking in the middle and north-east of the map with a question mark over them.

options.title: Madhya Pradesh, UP aur Bihar ek hi mahine mein kyun kate?
options.first_line: मध्य प्रदेश, उत्तर प्रदेश और बिहार, तीनों एक ही महीने में क्यों कटे?
options.first_frame: The three big old states lit as one colour each on India's map, a dashed cut line starting to draw across Madhya Pradesh.

why: Madhya Pradesh, UP and Bihar are states almost every viewer knows or lives in, and seeing a cut line start across them raises 'why were they cut, and into what?' without giving the answer, while B hides the subject and A already names the new states.
